description: Search Bayt.com jobs across 24 markets, paste job/search/company URLs, resolve specific job IDs, or pull a company profile and its open roles.

careerLevel.description: Filter by seniority. Bayt publishes this for some jobs, mostly employer postings.
careerLevel.title: Career level

city.description: Optional city name such as Dubai, Riyadh or Cairo. If Bayt has no page for the city, the search falls back to the whole country.
city.title: City

companyName.description: Optional employer name filter, for example Al Futtaim or Infosys. Bayt matches the employer facet, so partial names may work differently from exact names.
companyName.title: Company name

companyUrls.description: Bayt company profile URLs or numeric company IDs, used when Mode is Company profile.
companyUrls.title: Company URLs or IDs

country.description: Bayt market to search. Pick International for every country, or choose one of the 24 supported markets.
country.title: Market

datePosted.description: Only return jobs Bayt marks as posted within this window.
datePosted.title: Date posted

easyApplyOnly.description: Only return jobs that accept an application directly on Bayt.
easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply only

employmentType.description: Filter by the employment type Bayt publishes for the job.
employmentType.title: Employment type

includeCompanyJobs.description: In Company mode, also return the company's open roles as job records.
includeCompanyJobs.title: Include the company's open jobs

includeDetails.description: On: full descriptions, skills, preferred-candidate criteria, parsed salary and company metadata. Off: faster, listing-card fields only.
includeDetails.title: Visit each job page

industry.description: Filter by one of Bayt's employer industries.
industry.title: Industry

jobIds.description: Bayt job IDs such as 5498312, or full job URLs, used when Mode is Resolve job IDs.
jobIds.title: Job IDs or job URLs

maxItems.description: Overall record limit for the run. Bayt exposes at most about 10,000 results per single search.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxPages.description: Safety cap on listing pages per search. Bayt shows 30 jobs per page and stops near 10,000 results.
maxPages.title: Maximum pages per search

minSalary.description: Exclude jobs whose published USD monthly range ends below this amount. Jobs with no published salary are excluded when this is set.
minSalary.title: Minimum monthly salary (USD)

mode.description: What to scrape. Search jobs builds one Bayt search per query. Paste URLs accepts job, search or company links. Job IDs resolves specific postings. Company pulls a profile and its open roles.
enumTitles: Search jobs by keyword and filters
Paste job, search or company URLs
Resolve job IDs or job URLs
mode.title: Mode

searchQueries.description: One keyword per entry, for example accountant or software engineer. Several entries are searched in order and duplicates are removed.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sortBy.description: Newest first is best for monitoring. Most relevant is best for broad keyword research.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Job, search or company URLs, used when Mode is Paste URLs. Arabic and English Bayt URLs are accepted.
startUrls.title: URLs to scrape

title: Bayt.com Jobs Scraper Input
